ideas.title: +1 Horde Size 🧟
ideas.hook: You are one slow zombie. Every step you take adds +1 zombie to your horde. Shamble down a long street of fleeing townsfolk and see how big your horde is when you hit the barricade at the end.
core_loop: Walk forward to grow your horde by +1 per step
Catch fleeing townsfolk for bonus horde members
Smash the barricade at the end; bigger horde breaks stronger walls
Rebirth to start with a faster base zombie and new towns
ideas.twist: The townsfolk fight back with water hoses and fences. A bigger horde is also slower, so you have to pick when to sprint ahead with a small pack.
retention: Pet crows that add bonus zombies
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 2.07 momentum with 35 new games (high confidence; [UPD🎃] +1 Venom Evolution 20,970 CCU, +1 Spider Arm🕷️ 18,878). Escape / run jumped 0.90 this week to 1.49, and +1 × escape already has 9 new games together. Zombies is up 0.18 to 1.54 (Ragdoll Reality 🩸 15,895).
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games put you on the run from the horde. Here you are the horde, and the +1 counter is the size of the crowd you can see behind you.

ideas.title: +1 Frost Per Step ❄️
ideas.hook: The lava is rising. Every step you take gives you +1 frost, and your footprints freeze the lava into a platform you can stand on. Climb the volcano before the lava catches up.
core_loop: Run up the volcano while lava rises under you
Each step adds +1 frost; more frost freezes wider paths
Spend frost on ice walls, slides and jump pads
Reach the crater to bank frost and rebirth
ideas.twist: Every few minutes the volcano erupts and lava bombs melt your frozen paths, so players race to rebuild before the next wave.
monetization: Storage pass for more banked frost
retention: Ice pets that add frost per step
ideas.why_now: "+1 ___" titles sit at 2.31 momentum with 33 new games (high). Escape / run gained 0.90 this week to 1.49, and rising-floor runs are hot: DONT SPLASH has 59,626 CCU in an interior run. Ice / fire is a steady 1.37 with 11 new games (Firefighting Sim 🚒 5,336).
ideas.differentiator: Most +1 games just make a number bigger. Here the stat you earn is the floor under your feet, so stopping to upgrade is a real risk.

ideas.title: Make a Mosaic 🧩
ideas.hook: Crack coloured stones and lay them tile by tile into a giant mosaic on your plot. Visitors walk across your art and pay to see it. Rarer stones glow, sparkle or change colour at night.
core_loop: Collect coloured stones from the quarry
Place them on your plot's grid to make a mosaic
Visitors walk by and tip based on size and rarity
Buy a bigger grid and rarer stone types
ideas.twist: Each week there is a theme (a dragon, a pumpkin). Mosaics that match the theme get a crowd of extra visitors.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.88 momentum with 17 new games spread out (high; Paint and Hide! 🎨 9,769 CCU). Stones / rocks sits at 1.73 with 13 new games (Cut a Rock 13,609), and paint × stones is an open gap in the data.
ideas.differentiator: Stone games are about breaking rocks. Here the rocks are your paint, and the reward is a piece of art other players walk on.

ideas.title: Jail Snack Shop 🍩
ideas.hook: You run the snack counter inside a cartoon jail. Inmates pay in coins and favours. Every night someone tries a breakout through your shop, and you have to sound the alarm or join the run.
core_loop: Stock snacks and serve the inmate queue for coins
Unlock new snacks, a bigger counter and a vending wall
Each night a breakout starts in your shop
Choose: stop it for a guard bonus, or escape with them for a big payout
ideas.twist: Inmates hide escape tools in their orders. Spot a spoon in a donut order and you can trade it to the guards or keep it.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.64 momentum with 27 new games (high; [CH2] Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 23,498 CCU, 🧸 My Small Business 13,251). Prison / police is up 0.34 this week to 1.26 (Punch Out Of Prison 5,278), and Escape / run gained 0.90 to 1.49.
ideas.differentiator: Prison games are about escaping. Here you have a job inside, and every escape walks through your shop.

ideas.title: Build on a Giant 🏗️
ideas.hook: Your base sits on the back of a sleeping giant who wanders the map. Build upwards for cash. When the giant wakes up and shakes, anything not bolted down falls off.
core_loop: Build floors, shops and farms on your giant's back
Earn cash over time as the giant walks past towns
Bolt down your best parts before the giant wakes
Feed the giant to make it bigger so it can carry more
ideas.twist: When two giants meet they wrestle, and players on both bases race to hold on and steal fallen parts.
ideas.why_now: Tycoon is up 0.34 this week to 1.50 with 136 new games (high). Tycoon / base building is at 1.26 with 77 new games ([🎃]Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 24,304 CCU). Giant / huge jumped 0.60 this week to 1.38 (Raise The Biggest Family 9,970).
ideas.differentiator: Tycoon plots never move. Here the plot is alive, walks around, and tries to shake your base off.

ideas.title: Stack Cash to the Sky 💵
ideas.hook: Every cash bundle you earn becomes a block in your own tower. Climb your tower to reach sky worlds where cash is worth more. A richer player has a taller, harder climb.
core_loop: Earn cash at ground-level jobs and machines
Each bundle stacks onto your personal tower
Climb your tower obby to reach sky islands with better income
Upgrade bundle size so your tower grows faster
ideas.twist: Other players can climb your tower too. If they reach the top first, they take a slice of the cash at the summit.
ideas.why_now: Money / rich is at 1.92 momentum with 53 new games (high; [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 32,816 CCU). Tycoon is up 0.34 to 1.50, and obby × tycoon has 5 new games together ([🎃]Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 24,304). Linear course maps are at 1.83.
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Money tycoons show a cash number. Here your wealth is a tower you have to climb yourself, so being rich is also a challenge.

ideas.title: Suit Up for Space 👩‍🚀
ideas.hook: Design a spacesuit in 90 seconds, then everyone gets pushed out of the airlock. Suits are judged on style, and on whether they survive the meteor shower.
core_loop: Pick a helmet, suit, boots and jetpack and paint them
Step into the airlock with everyone else
Float through a meteor field; weak parts crack off
Players vote on the best-looking suit still in one piece
ideas.twist: Style and strength fight each other: the coolest parts are the flimsiest, so you decide how much to risk for votes.
ideas.why_now: Dress Up is up 0.15 this week to 1.20 with 17 new games ([🎃] Facecard: Makeup Showdown 5,113 CCU, Evermore High 🦢 9,696). Paint / create is at 1.88 (high). Space is up 0.22 to 1.64 ([🎃] Clean the Moon! 6,067).
ideas.differentiator: Dress-up games stop at the runway. Here the outfit is tested by physics before anyone votes.

ideas.title: Run From the Spellbooks 📚
ideas.hook: A wizard's library has come alive. Flying spellbooks chase you down corridors while you grab loose pages. Every full spell you collect gives you a power to escape further.
core_loop: Run through library halls while books chase you
Grab loose pages to complete spells
Use spells (blink, shield, slow time) to get past books
Reach the exit door of each wing to unlock the next
ideas.twist: Each spell you finish goes into your spell index. Some spells only appear on one floor at night.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run jumped 0.90 this week to 1.49 (high; [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 32,816 CCU). Interior maps are at 1.97 with 40 new games (DONT SPLASH 59,626, The Hollow 44,272). Fantasy is at 1.38 with 13 new games (🍀 Tower Of Luck [1.8] 4,608).
ideas.differentiator: Escape games give you nothing but legs. Here what you collect while running becomes the tools you escape with.

ideas.title: Storm Supply Shop ⛈️
ideas.hook: You run the only shop in a town hit by a new storm every few minutes. Sell the right gear before each storm lands: umbrellas before rain, sandbags before floods, helmets before hail.
core_loop: Check the forecast board for the next storm
Stock the right goods and sell to panicking townsfolk
Close the shutters when the storm hits
Spend profits on more shelves, a bigger warehouse and delivery vans
ideas.twist: The forecast is sometimes wrong. Stock for the wrong storm and you are stuck with gear nobody wants.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.64 momentum with 27 new games (high; Sell a Million Sushi 8,371 CCU). Disaster / weather jumped 1.02 this week to 1.86 ([🚗] Create A Disaster💥 4,945), though one game holds most of its players, so it is only the backdrop here. Shop × disaster is an open gap.
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games make you survive the storm. Here you profit from it, and the weather is your sales forecast.

ideas.title: Last Bus Out 🚌
ideas.hook: Drive a beat-up bus through a zombie town picking up survivors before the bridge closes. Each survivor you save pays you to upgrade the bus: armour, plows, a roof turret.
core_loop: Drive through town and stop to pick up survivors
Keep zombies off the bus while it is stopped
Reach the bridge before the timer runs out
Spend fares on armour, speed and seats
ideas.twist: Survivors have jobs: a mechanic fixes the bus on the move, a cook adds health. Who you pick up changes your run.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run gained 0.90 this week to 1.49 (high). Vehicle Sim is at 1.34 with 25 new games (🛡️[S1] Bike Universe 19,131 CCU, Night Rider 🏍️ [TESTING] 7,131). Zombies is up 0.18 to 1.54 with 11 new games (Steal and Cure a Zombie).
ideas.differentiator: Zombie escapes are on foot and solo. Here you drive, carry other people, and they change how your run goes.
